decisions.story_title: FBI posed as ransomware gang and fake victim in sting against data-recovery firm
decisions.reason: Primary reporting (sekurak.pl) on a real FBI sting: agents impersonated both a ransomware gang and an infected company to run a data-recovery scam, with concrete ransom figures ($13,000 quote, $13,260 + $2,750 offer, $6,000 settlement).
Futurism report on the n0n third-party vendor attack is the same story already carried (JPMorgan/Visa/Mastercard customer data leak).
Digest item links the Malwarebytes Chrome 158 article (204 fixes, six critical, two found with AI) already carried by this story.
ALA OIF post about bots scraping library catalogs; awareness/generic explainer, no vulnerability, attack, or breach with substance.
